messages:
hannah: Quiet heads-up — we closed our first enterprise Dedicated contract overnight. Also hit $1M ARR from that account. Tiny celebration in the kitchen at 3pm? :tada: :sparkles:
raj: OMG amazing!!! 🎉 Huge props to @hannah and @oliver. Donuts or ramen truck?
maria: Donuts ftw. I can handle ordering + stickers.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: Canary for prod-dedicated deployed to us-west-2 at 02:47 UTC — health checks green ✅
oliver: This is huge team effort. Adding a 3pm calendar 'mini-celebration' and a 15m photo slot. @people-ops can we do a small swag drop?
anya: Photo yes please. Also let's put a framed team pic in the kitchen.
emma: Quick poll: donuts :doughnut: or ramen :ramen: ? Reply with "donut" or "ramen"
hannah: Donut please. (unless someone REALLY wants ramen) :joy:
raj: donut
maria: donut — ordering from Bluebird unless anyone has objections. Any dietary restrictions?
anya: gf + vegan options pls!
oliver: I'll bring a tiny confetti cannon (office-safe) and my ridiculous party sunglasses.
dev-bot: Congrats team! Draft announcement created in #announcements — pinging comms for final wording.
hannah: Link (draft): https://internal.example.com/announcements/dedicated-win-2951234567 — Legal asked to use the phrase "partner launch" only, no customer names in public posts. Please respect that.
maria: Noted re: legal. I'll order stickers that say "Redwood Inference — Serving Wins" instead of client names.
raj: Also, low-key brag for the investors in 2 lines, then keep it quiet externally.
anya: Who's bringing the camera? I'll bring my lens.
emma: If anyone wants a sticker pack DM me "sticker" and I'll add you to the list.
hannah: Thank you all. Feels surreal — huge thanks to infra and sales and everyone who helped land this. Short thread: drop a clap emoji if you're in for 3pm.
raj: 👏👏👏
maria: 👏
oliver: 👏
anya: 👏 (and vegan donuts on me)
dev-bot: Reminder: Please do not share contract or ARR details outside the company. Use approved wording from comms.
hannah: Cool — see you at 3pm. Photos will be uploaded to #team-photos afterwards. 
raj: Can't wait. :partyparrot: 
maria: I'll bring napkins.
anya: ♥
oliver: Confetti primed.
infra-bot: nightly-backup: snapshot completed at 02:50 UTC — everything looks healthy.
dev-bot: Announce posted in #announcements (internal) — congrats again!
